name: @jacoblight-chen/dsh-ukma
description: UKMA for DSH — registers native `ukma_*` tools over a long-lived `ukma --mcp` child process (the UKMA code parse index is per-process, so per-call `--run-tool` cannot serve code queries). Setup commands (init/sync/status/uninit) run as one-shot `ukma` spawns; code / memory / system operations go through the persistent MCP child so the index is built once (code.analyze_repository) and reused. A system-prompt section makes the tools the preferred route for code search and memory recall.
